section.title: Scope
section.para: This chapter documents LuaRuntime lifecycle and binding registration functions. The scripting API should be intentionally small and useful. Expose stable operations before internal details.

section.title: Binding namespaces
section.para: lsat for SAT loading and solving. lsmt for SMT loading and solve status pathways. lsattyre for runtime paths and package environment helpers.

section.title: Error reporting
section.para: Surface Lua errors to callers and logs explicitly. Do not swallow script failures inside binding wrappers. Keep ownership clear: runtime owns lua_State lifecycle.

literallayout.computeroutput: // Lua errors should propagate to the caller in a clear way. // The binding layer should not hide the failure origin.

section.title: Scripting patterns
section.para: Expose create/load/solve/inspect primitives first. Keep module tables small and discoverable. Reuse the same data flow as the C++ APIs.

section.title: Testing suggestions
section.para: Use a Lua smoke test that initializes runtime and executes a tiny script. Validate both success path and deliberate failure path. Keep scripts in examples or tests for reproducibility.

section.title: Chapter summary
section.para: Stage 7 success means reliable runtime init and practical first bindings. Small, focused bindings are easier to keep stable. This forms the scripting bridge for advanced user workflows.
